proposed_operation.reasoning_fairness_policy: Compare four explicitly configured systems at supported low effort. Equal names or token caps do not imply equal computation. Retain original upstream visible reasoning instruction.
proposed_operation.model_call_order: Predeclare rotating/interleaved model-slot order across manifest-sorted smoke/development items. Record the exact schedule hash before collection.
proposed_operation.retry_owner: One audited gateway layer. Disable extra client/SDK retries and verify no nested retry multiplication.
proposed_operation.timeout_policy: Propose 600 seconds active provider execution per attempt, matching captured gateway default. Queue/client deadlines must exceed and expose the configured attempts. Reconcile an ambiguous timeout before blind resubmission.
proposed_operation.retry_after_precedence: Honor provider Retry-After. If it exceeds the configured individual or total waiting allowance, defer/stop rather than shorten the delay.
proposed_operation.model_or_provider_fallbacks: None proposed. Actual no-fallback behavior is unresolved through ScreamingFace.
proposed_operation.service_tier: Standard only proposed. Exact service-tier transport through the engine remains unverified.
proposed_operation.fresh_collection: Disable engine response reuse and preserve capture. Keep provider prompt caching as separately recorded billing behavior. The supported engine cache-control path remains unverified.
proposed_operation.input_guard_status: Proposed pre-dispatch check including actual provider message wrapper. A guard, not an observed input token count; no truncation of official prompts permitted.

privacy_policy.route_dependency: Strict ZDR can exclude the preferred first-party endpoints. Agree policy first, then verify an eligible exact endpoint and reprice any change.
